claims.object_text: genetic epilepsy with febrile seizures plus (GEFS+)
claims.quote: the occurrence of GEFS+ is mainly related to mutations in the gamma-aminobutyric acid type A receptor gamma 2 subunit (GABRG2) gene.
The predominant types of GABRG2 mutations include missense (c.983A → T, c.245G → A, p.Met199Val)
All of these mutations types can reduce the function of ion channels on the cell membrane;
The γ2 subunit plays a special role in receptor trafficking and is closely related to its structural specificity.
